_what: Every domain-tag change of 2026-09-06, node by node, before and after. Thomas: "get rid of the grok shit... promote those used 8 times or more." SIX tags were promoted to approved Domain values (semiconductors, human-capital, food, exchange-rate, gender, culture). FOUR place-or-generic tags were mapped to approved domains: proposed:statistics, proposed:capital and proposed:cdmx -> general-statistics, proposed:cross-strait -> trade. Every remaining proposed: tag was stripped, with general-statistics as the fallback for a node that would otherwise have had none. THE RULE APPLIED, which is narrower than "promote everything used 8+ times": promote a tag only if the approved 40 cannot express it; strip a tag whose nodes already carry an approved domain that covers it. That is why legal (12 uses, every node already on statistical-system), payments (9, on banking/monetary-policy), resources (9, on energy/mining/environment) and ageing (10, on population) were stripped despite clearing the threshold - promoting them would have imported the duplication rather than removed it. This file is the complete record and the only way back: there is no git safety net (PLAYBOOK rule 1).
